_comment: Curated per-language FST registrations consumed by scripts/derive-fsts.mjs
(merged into resources.fsts[] — resource EXISTENCE only, boundary invariant kind 2).
Seeded 2026-07-19 with the GiellaLT PRODUCTION-maturity languages missing from the
cards (the live-check lane in generate-language-card.mjs only ran for ~20 launch
languages). Maturity is GiellaLT's own published tier (map-maturity-prod.html), not
our judgment. NOTE the repo slug is not always the ISO code (Kalaallisut = lang-kl).
Per the fst_installer.py doctrine, entries carry NO install pins: GitHub releases
are vestigial for GiellaLT; distribution is their nightly channel.
Every entry MUST carry a source string citing its basis (index, not arbiter).

fao.name: GiellaLT Faroese FST (lang-fao)
